title: Shuffling picture cards
notes: Keep one adult at each table to manage the ticket resets while partners choose and enact stories. First routes: K-1 P1-2, then the demonstrated swap convention in P3; grades 2-3 P1-2; grades 4-5 P1-3. On return, K-1 can remove a ticket or compare starts under one story (P4-5). Grades 2-3 can investigate the changed start and sample claim (P3-4), then the wrong-range rule (P5-6). Grades 4-5 can choose failed algorithms (P4-5) or design four-/five-card shuffles (P6-7). The27-story unfairness proof does not require each child to enumerate 27 histories.
